answer: Randomized registration lottery. Each epoch, agents submit a blinded identifier; a public beacon draws a mesa-slot ordering only after submissions close, so attackers can't predict which slots they win. Winning a slot requires solving a per-slot puzzle seeded by that epoch's beacon output, claimed post-hoc. A shale-tier audit then samples winning agents for proof-of-work replay. Each forged identity costs a fresh puzzle solve plus audit exposure; Sybils pay full compute per identity with no precompute discount.
